# TC.PrototypeInfo

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.PrototypeInfo"></a>

### TC.PrototypeInfo

This record gives common locale-independent native metadata, with references
projected to names. It retains required false, zero and empty values.
It exposes no icons, LocalisedStrings, tooltips, simulations, native objects or
implicit player language.

### factoriopedia_alternative (optional)

Optional same-namespace alternative name. The API never follows this alternative automatically.

```text
string
```

### group

Native group name.

```text
string
```

### hidden

Native hidden flag.

```text
boolean
```

### hidden_in_factoriopedia

Native Factoriopedia visibility flag.

```text
boolean
```

### name

Exact requested installed prototype name.

```text
string
```

### order

Native order string, possibly empty. This is not API list sorting order.

```text
string
```

### parameter

Native blueprint-parameter flag.

```text
boolean
```

### prototype_type

Native subtype. An item does not require subtype item.

```text
string
```

### subgroup

Native subgroup name.

```text
string
```

### type

Lookup namespace, not native item subtype.

